---
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR removes the sequential inode sequencer, derives inodes deterministically (hard links hash HardLinkId; others hash FullPath+Crtime), restricts inode-index updates to hard-linked entries, updates store wrapper write/delete behavior, and adds tests verifying deterministic inode derivation. ## Changes **Deterministic Inode Derivation and Hard-Link-Only Indexing** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Remove inode sequencer dependency**
`weed/filer/filer.go`, `weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote_test.go`|Drops the `sequence` import, removes the `inodeSequencer` field from `Filer`, and stops initializing it in NewFiler and test factories.| |**Implement deterministic inode derivation**
`weed/filer/filer_inode.go`|Replaces sequencer-based inode assignment with deterministic hashing: initialize Crtime when missing; hard links derive inode from `HardLinkId`; regular entries derive inode from `FullPath` + `Crtime`.| |**Refactor inode index to hard-link-only model**
`weed/filer/filer_inode_index.go`|Removes recursive inode-index collectors; `recordInodeIndexWrite`/`recordInodeIndexRemoval` now accept `*Entry` and only act for entries with `HardLinkId`, non-zero `Attr.Inode`, and non-empty `FullPath`; KV failures are logged and not returned.| |**Test deterministic inode derivation**
`weed/filer/filer_inode_test.go`|Adds tests asserting stable inode derivation for non-hard-linked entries and shared inode derivation across entries with the same `HardLinkId`.| |**Update store wrapper to use new index functions**
`weed/filer/filerstore_wrapper.go`|Removes inline inode-index bookkeeping from `InsertEntry`, `InsertEntryKnownAbsent`, `UpdateEntry`, `DeleteEntry`, `DeleteOneEntry`, and `DeleteFolderChildren`; operations delegate to underlying store and rely on entry-driven index functions when applicable.| |**Dependency and command adjustments**
`go.mod`, `weed/command/command.go`|Removes NFS-related modules from `require` (or marks indirect) and removes `cmdNfs` from the exported `Commands` list.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 Sequencers hushed, the hashes sing, > Crtime set, hard links bind the ring, > Paths and times give inodes their face, > Index trimmed to links that trace, > A tidy filer hops in place.

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. |
✅ Passed checks (4 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title 'refactor(filer): remove the inode->path index and the NFS gateway' directly and clearly summarizes the main changes: removal of the inode-to-path index and the NFS gateway from the filer. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | The PR fully addresses the three primary coding objectives from issue `#9718`: (1) removes per-object inode index KV writes preventing unwanted filemeta growth, (2) eliminates the NFS gateway entirely as an alternative to a configuration option, and (3) replaces sequential inode assignment with deterministic hashing, removing the dependency on KV-based indexing. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | All changes directly support the core objective of removing the inode-path index and NFS gateway: filer inode derivation changes, NFS server/command removal, inode indexing logic elimination, test updates, and dependency cleanup are all in scope. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
